# Fixates

> Fixates is your personal command center for work, focus, and time. Built with Next.js 16, React 19, Supabase, and Tauri v2, it unifies deep-work focus timers, Google Calendar and ICS schedule synchronization, priority task checklists, habit streak analytics, and an AI agent voice command harness.

## Core Capabilities

- **Deep Work Focus Timer**: Interactive Pomodoro timer with configurable session lengths (25m standard, 50m deep work, custom durations), sound alarms, and active status tracking.
- **Calendar & Timeline Sync**: Seamless bi-directional synchronization with Google Calendar (via OAuth2) and Apple / ICS calendar feeds. Features real-time status calculation (ongoing, finished, upcoming) and timeline breakdown.
- **Smart Task Management**: Hierarchical task checklist supporting urgency/importance badges, priority tagging, completion percentages, and category sorting.
- **Habit Streaks & Analytics**: Visual habit consistency grid tracking consecutive workday streaks, focus energy, and daily efficiency scores.
- **AI Agent Tool Harness & Voice Control**: Integrated OpenAI/MCP tool schema harness with browser speech recognition for hands-free workflow actions (e.g. creating tasks, starting timers, checking upcoming meetings).
- **Dual View Modes**: Switch effortlessly between a 12-column responsive Bento-grid Canvas view and a chronological single-column Feed view.
- **macOS Desktop Integration**: Packaged with Tauri v2 for native desktop speed, global keyboard shortcuts (⌘K command palette), and local data storage.

## Indexable Routes & Navigation

- [/]: Fixates Dashboard & Command Center overview (live bento grid, greeting, quick notes, and daily target metrics)
- [/focus]: Dedicated Full-Screen Focus Mode & Pomodoro Workstation
- [/tasks]: Smart Task Management, Priority Checklist, and Tag Organizer
- [/calendar]: Interactive Schedule, Timeline Viewer, and Google Calendar Sync
- [/activity]: Habit Tracking, Workday Analytics, and Productivity Streaks
- [/reminders]: Time-Sensitive Alerts, Quick Reminders, and Daily Checklists

## Technical Stack & Architecture

- **Frontend Framework**: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4 with dark mode design tokens and glassmorphism styling
- **Hosting**: Cloudflare Workers (via OpenNext) and Tauri v2 desktop runtime
- **Database & Auth**: Supabase (PostgreSQL, Row Level Security) and WorkOS
- **API Endpoints**: Lightweight fetch-based OAuth2 and MCP agent tool execution

- Target Platforms: macOS (Tauri v2), Modern Web Browsers (PWA)
